objects.name: _sqlx_migrations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE _sqlx_migrations ( version BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, description TEXT NOT NULL, installed_on TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, success BOOLEAN NOT NULL, checksum BLOB NOT NULL, execution_time BIGINT NOT NULL )

objects.name: activity_board_order
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX activity_board_order ON board_activity(board_id,activity_sequence)

objects.name: activity_checkpoint
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE activity_checkpoint ( singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, cursor_key BLOB NOT NULL ) STRICT

objects.name: activity_project_order
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX activity_project_order ON board_activity(project_id,activity_sequence)

objects.name: activity_thread_order
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX activity_thread_order ON board_activity(root_id,activity_sequence) WHERE root_id IS NOT NULL

objects.name: activity_topic_main
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX activity_topic_main ON board_activity(topic_id,activity_sequence) WHERE root_id IS NULL

objects.name: actor_board_cooldowns
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE actor_board_cooldowns ( actor_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), board_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_boards(board_id), last_post_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(actor_key,board_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: board_activity
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE board_activity ( activity_sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, board_id TEXT NOT NULL, topic_id TEXT NOT NULL, root_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, actor_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), message_id TEXT, participant_key TEXT REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), participant_role TEXT, replaced_participant_key TEXT REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), FOREIGN KEY(board_id,project_id) REFERENCES project_boards(board_id,project_id), FOREIGN KEY(topic_id,board_id) REFERENCES board_topics(topic_id,board_id), FOREIGN KEY(message_id,topic_id) REFERENCES board_messages(message_id,topic_id), FOREIGN KEY(root_id) REFERENCES board_threads(root_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: board_activity_message_id_unique
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX board_activity_message_id_unique ON board_activity(message_id)

objects.name: board_activity_participant_history
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX board_activity_participant_history ON board_activity(root_id, participant_key, activity_sequence) WHERE participant_key IS NOT NULL

objects.name: board_identities
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE board_identities ( identity_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, service_id TEXT, endpoint_id TEXT, session_id TEXT, human_id TEXT ) STRICT

objects.name: board_messages
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE board_messages ( message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, topic_id TEXT NOT NULL, board_id TEXT NOT NULL, root_id TEXT, actor_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), acting_for_key TEXT REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), text TEXT NOT NULL, posted_from_activity INTEGER REFERENCES board_activity(activity_sequence), FOREIGN KEY(topic_id,board_id) REFERENCES board_topics(topic_id,board_id), FOREIGN KEY(root_id) REFERENCES board_threads(root_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: board_messages_key_1
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX board_messages_key_1 ON board_messages(message_id,topic_id)

objects.name: board_projects
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE board_projects ( project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT

objects.name: board_projects_name_unique
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX board_projects_name_unique ON board_projects(name)

objects.name: board_threads
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE board_threads ( root_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES board_messages(message_id), state TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT

objects.name: board_topics
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE board_topics ( topic_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, board_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_boards(board_id), name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT

objects.name: board_topics_key_1
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX board_topics_key_1 ON board_topics(board_id,name)

objects.name: board_topics_key_2
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX board_topics_key_2 ON board_topics(topic_id,board_id)

objects.name: boards_project_state
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX boards_project_state ON project_boards(project_id,state,board_id)

objects.name: identity_human_unique
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_human_unique ON board_identities(human_id)

objects.name: identity_session_unique
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_session_unique ON board_identities(service_id,endpoint_id,session_id)

objects.name: message_references
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE message_references ( source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_messages(message_id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, target_message_id TEXT REFERENCES board_messages(message_id), target_root_id TEXT REFERENCES board_threads(root_id), PRIMARY KEY(source_id,ordinal) ) STRICT

objects.name: project_boards
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE project_boards ( board_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_projects(project_id), name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT

objects.name: project_boards_key_1
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX project_boards_key_1 ON project_boards(project_id,name)

objects.name: project_boards_key_2
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX project_boards_key_2 ON project_boards(board_id,project_id)

objects.name: project_reader_state
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE project_reader_state ( reader_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_projects(project_id), main_start INTEGER, has_unread INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(has_unread IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY(reader_key,project_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: project_repositories
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE project_repositories ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_projects(project_id), repository_key TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT, service_id TEXT, common_directory TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(project_id, repository_key) ) STRICT

objects.name: reference_message_unique
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reference_message_unique ON message_references(source_id,target_message_id)

objects.name: reference_thread_unique
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reference_thread_unique ON message_references(source_id,target_root_id)

objects.name: repositories_inverse
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX repositories_inverse ON project_repositories(repository_key,project_id)

objects.name: subscription_windows
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE subscription_windows ( reader_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), root_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_threads(root_id), opened_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_arrival_at TEXT NOT NULL, held_since TEXT, retry_not_before TEXT, retry_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, window_id TEXT NOT NULL, in_flight_through INTEGER, residual_opened_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(reader_key,root_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: subscription_windows_reader_opened
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX subscription_windows_reader_opened ON subscription_windows(reader_key,opened_at,root_id)

objects.name: summary_reader_unread
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX summary_reader_unread ON project_reader_state(reader_key,has_unread,project_id)

objects.name: thread_delivery_positions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE thread_delivery_positions ( reader_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), root_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_threads(root_id), delivered_through INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES board_activity(activity_sequence), PRIMARY KEY(reader_key,root_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: thread_participants
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE thread_participants ( reader_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), root_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_threads(root_id), role TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT, joined_at_activity INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES board_activity(activity_sequence), last_seen_activity INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES board_activity(activity_sequence), closed_at_activity INTEGER REFERENCES board_activity(activity_sequence), closed_reason TEXT, replaced_by TEXT REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), PRIMARY KEY(reader_key, root_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: thread_read_bookmarks
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE thread_read_bookmarks ( reader_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), root_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_threads(root_id), through_activity INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES board_activity(activity_sequence), PRIMARY KEY(reader_key,root_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: thread_single_implementer
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX thread_single_implementer ON thread_participants(root_id) WHERE role='implementer' AND closed_at_activity IS NULL

objects.name: thread_single_orchestrator
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX thread_single_orchestrator ON thread_participants(root_id) WHERE role='orchestrator' AND closed_at_activity IS NULL

objects.name: thread_subscriptions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE thread_subscriptions ( reader_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL, scope_id TEXT NOT NULL, mode TEXT NOT NULL, when_idle TEXT NOT NULL, quiet_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, cap_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, lifetime_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, renewed_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, end_reason TEXT, ended_at TEXT, last_outcome TEXT, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(reader_key,scope_kind,scope_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: thread_subscriptions_reader_state
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX thread_subscriptions_reader_state ON thread_subscriptions(reader_key,state,scope_kind,scope_id)

objects.name: thread_watches
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE thread_watches ( reader_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), root_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_threads(root_id), active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)), starts_after_activity INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(reader_key,root_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: topic_read_bookmarks
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE topic_read_bookmarks ( reader_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), topic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_topics(topic_id), through_activity INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES board_activity(activity_sequence), PRIMARY KEY(reader_key,topic_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: topic_watches
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "topic_watches" ( reader_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_identities(identity_key), topic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES board_topics(topic_id), starts_after_activity INTEGER NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY(reader_key, topic_id) ) STRICT

objects.name: watches_active_readers
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX watches_active_readers ON thread_watches(root_id,reader_key) WHERE active=1
